name: SAVECO Online Hypermarket
note: Kuwait's largest hypermarket chain (Al-Qatami Group, est. 2013), grocery/general merchandise (approved) with live online ordering and delivery via Talabat, WhatsApp and its own site. Kuwait HQ is in-scope; original OUT rested on a false 'Savola arm' premise plus a 'no domain on file' data gap, not a real disqualifier.

name: Sameh Mall
note: Independently verified as an Egyptian (Cairo) food/grocery ordering-and-delivery marketplace. HQ outside Saudi Arabia/Kuwait/Qatar, so Gate 1 geography exclusion is correct.

name: ajlanbros
note: Ajlan & Bros is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia menswear/apparel business (thobe, ghutra, yashmagh, winter, underwear) that manufactures AND runs a live consumer e-store at ajstore.com plus physical branches. Apparel is an approved category; the 'building_materials' tag was flatly wrong and the retail arm passes on its own merits (Lazurde hybrid pattern).

name: daralmasalla
note: Dar Al-Masalla (Saudi) manufactures/distributes marble, quartz, sanitaryware, bathroom fixtures and interior finishing, plus design services. Construction/sanitary materials are hard-excluded under Gate 2 even though an online store exists.

name: 3attar
note: Independently verified as a Cairo/Maadi, Egypt foodtech startup (founded 2019, Egyptian seed round) selling healthy food/spices. HQ is Egyptian, not Saudi; Gate 1 geography exclusion is correct.

name: darent
note: Darent (Saudi, Ministry of Tourism-licensed) is a holiday-homes / short-term rental booking marketplace (villas, chalets, apartments). Travel/hospitality plus real estate plus marketplace, all hard-excluded and not product retail; the cart/checkout keyword was a booking-flow false positive.

name: edadcom
note: Edadcom is a Saudi B2C store, but it sells power tools, hand tools, welding gear, generators, air compressors and water pumps: hardware/industrial tools (Gate 2 hardware exclusion) with low repeat-purchase (Gate 3). Exclusion stands despite the mislabeled 'building_materials' tag.

name: Food Unit Company
note: Riyadh F&B holding operating multiple restaurant/QSR brands plus food manufacturing, wholesale and some specialty food retail. Approved F&B category and Saudi HQ make the 'wholesale_distribution' exclusion inaccurate, but no dedicated consumer e-commerce store or scaled app could be confirmed; genuinely ambiguous.

name: Fuel Way
note: Fuel Way (Dhahran, Saudi) operates 50+ fuel stations with maintenance and F&B partners, no online cart. Fuel-station operator is hard-excluded; the 'building_materials' tag was wrong but the exclusion is correct.

name: GULF STREAM
note: Kuwait 'General Trading & Contracting Co.' doing project/EPC and pre-commissioning work, with a services/projects site and no catalog or cart. B2B contracting is hard-excluded.

name: jazeerapaints
note: Jazeera Paints (Riyadh, 1979) is a paint manufacturer (5 plants, ~400k tonnes/yr) with 750+ showrooms. Manufacturing plus construction/decorating material plus a narrow low-repeat single line (Gates 2/3); the retail footprint does not rescue an excluded category.

name: Juffali Commercial Vehicles
note: Sole Mercedes-Benz and FUSO trucks/buses agent and distributor in Saudi Arabia (Jeddah/Riyadh/Dammam). Automotive (commercial vehicles) is hard-excluded.

name: J:OIL | جي اويل
note: J:OIL is Al-Jeri Oil Station Company (Riyadh), a fuel-station and service-center operator (fuel, auto maintenance, cafes). Fuel-station operator is hard-excluded.

name: industry
note: industry.com.sa is a B2B e-marketplace/directory connecting Saudi factories and suppliers with importers and buyers, not a consumer retail store. B2B marketplace is hard-excluded.

name: kabrita
note: Kabrita is a Dutch goat-milk infant-formula brand (Ausnutria); kabrita.sa is the foreign brand's local ccTLD storefront (Gate 1 fail) and a single narrow product line (Gate 3). Exclusion correct.

name: Al Khairat Company
note: Al Khairat is a Saudi B2B distributor of stationery, toys and bags (Deli, Zebra, Stabilo, BIC, etc.) serving 1500+ retailers, with an informational site, no cart and no pricing. Wholesale/distribution as the primary identity with no dedicated consumer retail arm (Gate 2) and no live transactional store (Gate 4).

name: kaifalshiuokh
note: Kaif Al Shuyoukh is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Arabic/Saudi coffee roaster-retailer with its own online store, home delivery and a Google Play app, widely distributed. Coffee is an approved, high-repeat F&B category; the 'building_materials' tag was wrong. SKU breadth is moderate but geography, category and a genuine D2C channel all qualify.

name: Kiffa Roaster
note: Kiffa is a Saudi (Madinah) specialty coffee roaster with a live online store (single origins, blends, capsules, instant, Turkish coffee, gift cards) plus a physical cafe. Coffee is an approved, repeat-purchase F&B category; the 'building_materials' tag was a false keyword hit.

name: lifepillarsmc
note: Life Pillars (Riyadh) is a B2B medical-device and aesthetics distributor supplying hospitals and clinics, ISO 13485 certified, with no cart. Healthcare plus B2B distribution is hard-excluded; the 'building_materials' tag was wrong but exclusion is correct.

name: Alfardan Premier Motors Company
note: Alfardan Premier Motors (Qatar) is the Land Rover/Jaguar dealership (new and approved-used vehicle sales, service, parts). Automotive is hard-excluded despite an online accessories store.

name: Lexus Turkey
note: lexus.com.sa is the official Lexus Saudi Arabia dealership operated by Abdul Latif Jameel Motors, selling automobiles (pricing in SAR). Automotive is hard-excluded; the record's 'Lexus Turkey' name is a mislabel of the KSA site.

name: Liter Group Company
note: Liter is a Saudi fuel-station network (petrol/diesel, car wash, oil change, convenience, EV charging) with no consumer e-commerce cart. Fuel-station operator is hard-excluded.

name: Knoz El Hekma - شركة كنوز الحكمة
note: Knoz Elhekma (Jeddah) is an investment holding company spanning manufacturing, retail and contracting, with subsidiaries including Kitchen City and Rozal Steel and no consumer storefront on the holding page. Mixed conglomerate with hard-excluded divisions, parent excluded per Gate 6.

name: maatic
note: Live Shopify apparel store but configured USD / US / en_US with no SAR or KSA address, and independent search could not place it among Saudi brands. Saudi HQ cannot be established, so the geography-based hold (originally 'Held') is upheld.
